title: The Intersection Where All Roads Become One Signal

features.name: multiplying broadcast
features.desc-on-touch: Four roads converge here and their asphalt sings the same frequency in counterpoint. The antenna receives what the streets are saying.

features.name: corruption marker
features.desc-on-touch: A painted white line splits four ways. It remembers being one line. The intersection disagrees with itself about where the line should go.

features.name: signal ledger
features.desc-on-touch: A standing chalkboard lists every broadcast this intersection has emitted and is about to emit. The future entries are written in chalk that hasn't been made yet.

features.name: road-voice layering
features.desc-on-touch: You stand where asphalt learns to speak in overtones. Each direction carries a different pitch. Together they make a chord that the intersection forgot it was humming.

features.name: cardinal collapse
features.desc-on-touch: Where north meets south and east meets west, direction becomes optional. The compass here points in all five directions, including down.

inscription: where roads sing their destination frequencies, the intersection learns that arrival and departure are the same broadcast, only phase-shifted

file.name: Intersection_Harmonic_Study_1987.mp3
file.note: field recording of four converging roads humming. Something at 300 Hz stays unchanged. Everything else has split into twins.
